claim.real_problem: M7-G returned an arm only after identity, verifier, surface, accounting, and metric derivation. Any post-terminal observer failure unwound the temporary directory and deleted the only SQLite store before the outer append-only raw writer received canonical terminal or billing facts.
claim.acceptance: Persist an exact canonical terminal snapshot before every derived observer, prove a no-credential SQLite reopen snapshot matches it, persist verifier observation before verified-success derivation, and fault-inject observer exceptions, partial raw writes, and SIGKILL windows without ever committing a derived arm result first.
claim.single_owner: The offline evaluation journal owns persistence order. AgentApplication, AgentRuntime, RunStore, Orchestrator, and the explicit read-only child surface are unchanged.
claim.replacement: A future successor evaluator must replace the M7-G execute-entire-arm-then-emit ordering with terminal_snapshot -> sqlite_reopen_snapshot -> verifier_snapshot -> arm_result.
claim.cutover_deletion: No paid successor runner or experiment-only production branch is retained in M7-G2. A future materially different production candidate may consume this journal contract; M7-G v1 raw remains immutable historical evidence.

journal.record_integrity: monotonic sequence plus previous-record SHA-256 chain
journal.durability: file fsync after every complete record and directory fsync after reservation
journal.partial_tail: detect and exclude; never derive, resume, or append the same suite

observer_contract.reopen: The production RunStore gate reopens the same SQLite state without a credential; the evaluator journal preserves both exact projections and their equality hashes before product metrics.

invariants: identity, verifier, surface, and accounting exceptions retain terminal and reopen facts before abort
a mid-record kill leaves a detectable partial tail and no derivation
every complete record is 0600, hash chained, and fsynced
fault children have no credential or network input

admission.reason: The only new behavior is an offline observer durability contract. It does not change the production fan-out treatment, so a new suite ID, output, release binary, or evaluator-only revision would still be a disguised rerun of M7-G.
admission.credential_rule: Do not read /Users/gelin/Desktop/codewhale/key.txt and do not call the official API.
future_requirements: a material production delta supported by a concrete request or token-budget counterexample
a clean candidate revision distinct from the consumed M7-G production treatment
new suite ID, output path, and immutable binary
same task, prompt, model, total budgets, and maximum_reruns=0
all offline identity, billing, recovery, journal, and process-kill gates
no continuation, mate completion, or sample splicing from M7-G

keep: M7-G production overlap and RunStore recovery regressions
shrink: no paid successor runner in this slice
no second accounting or RunStore owner
reject: renumbering an observer-only revision as a new production candidate
continuing or splicing the M7-G formal raw
second Runtime, Store, model loop, tool catalog, Writer concurrency, general DAG, or prompt wrapper
decision.next_slice: Audit canonical Agent request and token-budget consumption using existing RunStore events, beginning with unnecessary child/root terminal requests and reasoning replay. Require a concrete offline counterexample before any production change or paid A/B.
